states.name: S0_POWER_UP
states.description: Pseudo-state entered once at instance initialization.
entry_actions: Initialize all internal and output registers to declared initial values.

states.name: S1_SIGNAL_INVALID
states.description: THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID is FALSE. Alarm and hold are forced off; no fault record or runtime add occurs. Statistics/history are preserved.
entry_actions: Do not clear FaultCounter_Int, RuntimeAccumulator_Int, or FaultHistory_Int

states.name: S2_VALID_NORMAL
states.description: Valid signal, no thickness fault, no active alarm hold.

states.name: S3_VALID_FAULT
states.description: Valid signal and THICKNESS_FAULT TRUE. Alarm is forced TRUE. Fault recording occurs on entry from a non-fault/invalid state.

states.name: S4_VALID_HOLD
states.description: Valid signal, fault absent, minimum 500 ms alarm hold active.

actions: keep alarm off and hold cleared

transitions.condition: THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND NOT THICKNESS_FAULT AND NOT AlarmHoldTimer.Q
THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND NOT THICKNESS_FAULT AND AlarmHoldTimer.Q
THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND NOT THICKNESS_FAULT AND NOT AlarmHoldTimer.Q
THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND NOT THICKNESS_FAULT AND AlarmHoldTimer.Q

timers.name: AlarmHoldTimer
timers.IN: THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND holdActive AND NOT holdRestart
reset_conditions: fresh valid THICKNESS_FAULT rising edge via holdRestart = TRUE for one scan
timers.purpose: Enforces the minimum 500 ms alarm hold from the most recent valid fault rising edge. Q TRUE means 500 ms elapsed.

timer_plan.one_shot_reset: holdRestart is cleared at the start of each scan and set TRUE only on validFaultRise. It forces AlarmHoldTimer.IN FALSE during the edge scan so a fresh edge restarts the 500 ms timing.

priorities: 1. Invalid signal override: THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID = FALSE forces THICKNESS_ALARM = FALSE, clears holdActive/holdRestart, resets AlarmHoldTimer, and suppresses fault records and runtime accumulation.
2. Valid fault override: THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID = TRUE AND THICKNESS_FAULT = TRUE forces THICKNESS_ALARM = TRUE regardless of timer state.
3. Minimum hold: after a valid fault rising edge, holdActive keeps THICKNESS_ALARM TRUE for at least 500 ms when the fault is absent; a fresh valid fault rising edge restarts the hold.
4. Fault history update: only validFaultRise records a fault. Persistent faults, invalid inputs, and held faults do not create records.
5. Normal runtime: accumulate CycleTime only when THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID = TRUE AND THICKNESS_FAULT = FALSE AND CUTTING_RUN = TRUE; otherwise preserve the accumulator.

6. Observation-only statistics: fault counter, runtime accumulator, and fault history never alter cutting permissives. History is updated only from private internal state and copied to the output in the output stage.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
actions: Latch inputs: THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID, THICKNESS_FAULT, CUTTING_RUN, FaultTimestamp, CycleTime.
Compute validFaultRise := validFault AND NOT prevValidFault.
Update prevValidFault := validFault for the next scan; invalid input leaves it FALSE.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: FIRST apply invalid-signal override: if NOT THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID, force alarm/hold off, reset timer via IN=FALSE, clear prevValidFault, and skip records/runtime.

Else, if validFaultRise, record fault: increment FaultCounter_Int, shift FaultHistory_Int toward higher indices, set FaultHistory_Int[0] := FaultTimestamp, set holdActive := TRUE, and holdRestart := TRUE.
If THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND NOT THICKNESS_FAULT AND CUTTING_RUN, add CycleTime to RuntimeAccumulator_Int.
If THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND NOT THICKNESS_FAULT AND AlarmHoldTimer.Q, clear holdActive.
Never clear statistics/history on invalid signal; preserve them.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: Call AlarmHoldTimer(IN := THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND holdActive AND NOT holdRestart, PT := T#500ms) exactly once per scan.
Timer Q and ET are updated here, unconditionally and outside any CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
actions: THICKNESS_ALARM := THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID AND (THICKNESS_FAULT OR (holdActive AND NOT AlarmHoldTimer.Q)).
